description.value: Boston Pizza Broadway is a Canadian chain family restaurant and sports bar located on West Broadway in Vancouver, celebrating 60 years as Canada's largest casual dining brand. The menu spans gourmet pizzas, pasta, wings, sandwiches, and shareables, with vegan and GlutenWise® options available. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience alongside takeout and delivery service on a busy urban corridor.
